About me

I am originally from Maine, and spent the past four years living in Scotland and studying Geography at the University of St Andrews. I just got a job working at Phillips Academy, Andover, and am hoping to move to Cambridge! I have sensible hobbies (running, hiking, cooking, finding live music) and silly hobbies (kickball, boogie boarding, making superfluous websites). I am 23 and use she/her pronouns.

Why you should live with me

I care a lot about the place that I live! Happy roommates, happy life. I am kind, clean and respectful of house culture, and I really enjoy getting to know my roommates. I am proactive about creating fun and am always down for house events (dinners, movie nights, outings).

What I am looking for

  • 3+ bed apartment (the more the merrier)
  • Move in date Nov 1st (flexible)
  • Cambridge, Somerville or Charlestown
  • Maximum budget 1,400/mo.
  • Happy friendly roommates
